issues.where: crops A, C, E and G, across the close-up globe
issues.what: The cloud texture becomes soft and directionally smeared over large areas. Even the bright cloud tops in C have little internal definition at native size.
issues.fix: Add finer cloud structure at the close-up scale and reduce directional texture blur while preserving the broad atmospheric bands.

issues.where: crop Q, center of the large vortex
issues.what: The filaments curl into a tight oval around a smooth, horizontally smeared center. The abrupt change in texture makes the eye look pinched rather than naturally resolved.
issues.fix: Rework the vortex core so fine filaments taper into the eye without collapsing into flat horizontal streaks.

issues.where: crops K and M, sunlit limb
issues.what: A nearly white rim and broad glow wash out the cloud detail just inside the illuminated edge.
issues.fix: Reduce the bloom peak and preserve the fine cloud contrast immediately inside the limb.

issues.where: crops V and W, lower-right star field
issues.what: Several brighter stars read as soft, slightly elongated blue-white blobs with colored fringes instead of distinct points.
issues.fix: Use a tighter star profile and reduce color fringing, reserving larger halos for the brightest stars.

issues.where: whole disc, especially upper half (crops J, K, C, O)
issues.what: the planet surface is smeared and painterly, with directional streaks that look like motion blur or a brush smudge; cloud tufts are soft blobs with no fine structure, so the disc reads as airbrushed and blurry at native size
issues.fix: re-render the atmosphere texture at higher resolution with crisp, layered band and cloud detail; remove the directional smear filter

issues.what: the vortex looks pasted on: a ring of bright, scribbly white strokes around a dark hole, with a different texture and sharpness from the surrounding smeared surface, and no flow of the bands into it
issues.fix: blend the storm into the band flow with matching resolution and shading, and give it a spiral structure that pulls the nearby clouds in

issues.where: ring arc endpoints at the limb, left and right (crops J, B, H, Q)
issues.what: the rings rise from the horizon and drop back into it like a rainbow, and their strands end in sharp, tapered points right on the limb; nothing shows the ring passing in front of or behind the planet, and there is no ring shadow
issues.fix: draw the ring as a full ellipse with a front section crossing the disc, occlusion behind the limb, and a shadow cast on the clouds

issues.where: ring strands across the sky (crops B, C, F, G, K)
issues.what: the rings are made of thin scratch-like streaks of uneven brightness that look like brush strokes or long-exposure trails rather than particle bands; some strands split and fade at random points
issues.fix: render the rings with a radial density profile and consistent gaps along the whole arc

issues.where: left of the disc (crops B, F, N)
issues.what: faint vertical ring lines appear only off the left limb and do not continue around or in front of the planet, so they read as stray hairline marks
issues.fix: either remove them or render a coherent ring system that wraps around the planet

issues.where: lower left night side (crops D, N, S, T)
issues.what: a large flat, near-black area with no surface detail and faint blotchy gradient steps
issues.fix: add faint night-side detail or dither the gradient to remove the blotches

issues.where: middle terrain and clouds (crops A, E, P, V)
issues.what: the cloud streaks are soft and slightly smeared, with low fine detail at native size
issues.fix: sharpen the cloud layer and add small-scale structure

issues.what: the small crescent moon is soft and has little surface detail
issues.fix: render the moon with crisp terminator and surface texture
